content:
Rumors have long suggested that Apple has been working on a major revamp of its Home lineup, and a new leak has now listed a series of products to look forward to.

macOS 程式碼外洩　提及多款未發布嘅 Home 裝置

Apple's most important launch event of the year is just weeks away, and is expected to showcase the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Ultra, new Apple Watch models, and reveal a new lineup of Home products.

Rumored products include a new Apple TV 4K, HomePod mini 2, and the long-awaited HomePad, but there are several other Home products that could launch in the near future too.

Yesterday, MacRumors spotted references to several unannounced products in the newly released macOS 26.7 RC.

These include codenames related to Home devices, quoting Juli Clover:

  • HomePad (J490 and J491): "J490 is believed to be a tabletop home hub version, while J491 is designed to be wall-mounted."
  • HomePod mini 2 (B525): The HomePod mini carries the codename B520, so this is likely the mini 2.
  • Home Accessory (J229): Likely the rumored security camera product.
  • HomeAccessory17,2 and HomeAccessory17,3: Newly mentioned unknown Home devices.
  • ATVRemote1,5: The next-generation Siri Remote, expected to launch alongside the new Apple TV 4K.

Other Home products reportedly in development include a video doorbell and a desktop robotic home hub, though it's unclear whether their codenames appeared in this macOS 26.7 leak.

Beyond products, MacRumors also spotted a reference called "Pebble," believed to be the codename for homeOS. There was also a string "audio_accessory_visual_reasoning," which could be related to the HomePad.

Finally, the leak also revealed an unspecified Home accessory available in four colors: Rose, Silver, Space Gray, and Starlight.

最佳 Apple Home 配件推薦

  • 支援 HomeKit 安全影片嘅 eufy 4K 鏡頭
  • 配備 Apple Home Key 同 UWB 嘅 Aqara 智能門鎖
  • HomeKit 車庫門開關控制器
  • HomeKit 智能插座（四裝）
  • 具備自適應溫度功能嘅 Aqara 智能溫控器
